hero.title: IndabaX São Tomé and Príncipe
hero.subtitle: Be part of a growing movement shaping the future of AI in Africa through collaboration, community, and cutting-edge discussions.

about.title: About IndabaX São Tomé and Príncipe
about.who_desc: We're a local AI community under the Deep Learning Indaba family, passionate about making artificial intelligence education accessible in São Tomé and Príncipe.
about.what_desc: We organize workshops, talks, and hands-on sessions to equip students, researchers, and tech lovers with practical AI skills and global connections.
about.why_desc: AI will shape the future of Africa. Being part of IndabaX helps you learn, network, and contribute to solutions that matter for our communities.

eventOverview.title: Why Attend this Event
eventOverview.description: This event brings together tech enthusiasts, industry leaders, and innovators to explore emerging solutions in tech and connect over meaningful discussions. Whether you're a developer, entrepreneur, or curious learner — there's something here for you!

expert_talks.title: Expert Talks
expert_talks.desc: Learn from leading experts and professionals across tech and innovation spaces.

workshops.title: Workshops
workshops.desc: Hands-on sessions to deepen your skills and apply knowledge in real time.

networking.title: Networking
networking.desc: Meet founders, developers, and entrepreneurs from all over the region.

organisers.sectionDescription: Our organisers are a dedicated team of experts and visionaries who work behind the scenes to make this event possible. With diverse skills and passion, they bring creativity, coordination, and care to ensure every detail runs smoothly.

luella.bio: South African technologist driving African innovation through AI, finance, and community building.

santos.bio: Helder ensures the heartbeat of São Tomé is reflected in every part of this event. Logistics, local outreach, and venue magic.

france.bio: France turns ideas into visuals — shaping the identity of the event from branding to stage design.

sloane.bio: Brings global and African AI voices to the table, curating a speaker lineup that sparks dialogue and impact.

zandile.bio: Zanele connects people before, during, and after the event — turning attendees into a community.
